mentions.name: VDA5050 Mobile Robot Visualization Tool
mentions.description: A visualization tool for fleets of mobile robots that communicate via the VDA5050 standard, built with Rust and wgpu. It aims to stay fast and resource-efficient where existing visualization solutions are slow or resource intensive, especially for larger robot fleets.
mentions.problem: Existing VDA5050 visualization solutions are slow, resource intensive, or both, especially for larger fleets of robots.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've started building a visualization tool for mobile robots using the VDA5050 communication standard.

evidence.value: I've started building a visualization tool for mobile robots using the VDA5050 communication standard.
